title: Cross Your Fingers, Touch Your Nose: Two Noses? #brain #illusion
description:
Cross two fingers and rub the tip of your nose (shut your eyes if you can). Many people feel two noses. Your fingers are not numb or confused: the skin reports exactly what it touches. The trick is in your brain. Crossed, your nose touches the outer sides of the two fingers. In a normal, uncrossed hand those two sides face away from each other, so they can only ever touch two different things at once. Your brain still reads the fingers as uncrossed, so it reports two objects. This is Aristotle's illusion, and Aristotle wrote about it more than two thousand years ago. It works with a pea, a marble or a pen too.
